tagline.en: The world's first eSIM store with 200+ destinations
tagline.zh: 全球首家eSIM商店，覆盖200+目的地

description.en: Airalo is the world's leading eSIM marketplace, offering prepaid data plans for more than 200 countries and regions. Plans start from 1GB for 7 days, install in minutes via the iOS/Android app, and top-ups are instant. A solid default choice for most travelers.
description.zh: Airalo 是全球领先的eSIM商城，为200多个国家和地区提供预付费流量套餐。套餐从1GB/7天起，通过iOS/Android应用几分钟即可安装激活，续购即时生效。是大多数旅行者的稳妥之选。

en: Top up anytime without changing SIM
